monetization.reason: No approved affiliate program or tracking ID is configured in the repository. The conversion improvement is a product-neutral liquid-measuring decision system covering label instructions, mL versus mg, oral syringes, supplied droppers, cups, calibrated spoons, graduations, capacity, package fit, accessibility, care, first-year cost, and return testing. It adds no merchant, model, price, coupon, ranking, availability claim, fabricated test, product image, or paid placement and preserves supplied-device and no-purchase outcomes.

image_qa.note: The cognition guide, liquid-measuring guide, and publication-history trust control use semantic text, tables, checklists, and existing brand interface assets. No cannabis product, person, brain image, measuring device, merchant, affiliate, stock, or generated image was added or changed, so no exact-product mismatch or new licensing issue was introduced.

search_console.decision: The October 5–November 1 report showed 786 impressions, four clicks, 0.509% CTR, and average position 24.632. The only new non-navigational signal in the approximate position-4-to-20 band was ‘510 vs disposable’ at two impressions and position 12; that sample is too weak, and an existing substantial comparison already serves the intent, so it was deliberately not expanded or duplicated. Delaware had one click, Montana one impression, and the HTTP federal-property and pre-roll rows one impression each; those were also too small. Blue Dream had 18 impressions but sat near position 45 and was not used to create another strain variation. No item is primarily Data-led. The report instead acted as a cannibalization guard while this batch fills distinct evidence, shopping, and trust gaps.

authority.action: Published a citation-worthy cognition evidence guide anchored by current CDC guidance, a 2025 meta-analysis, a systematic review, and a large young-adult study. Its domain map, evidence-window matrix, confounder screen, product-time-task record, claim screen, and clinical/work handoff strengthen residual-impairment, older-adult safety, driving, and research-literacy paths through reciprocal contextual links. No tightly matched unsolicited outreach target was strong enough to log, and no outreach was sent.
